items.statement: Within the specified sodium-associated solution model, C-site sulfur transfer is kinetically favored over O-site sulfur transfer.
items.expected: The validated comparison selects C_site as lower barrier, with the caveat that this is an initial-substitution model result.

items.statement: The source-supported explanation emphasizes stronger noncovalent interactions in TS2; the source does not support treating NPA charges as the cause of the barrier ordering.
items.expected: The conclusion names the interaction comparison and states the charge-analysis limitation.

items.statement: The complete cascade and inorganic-base participation are not fully established by the computational profile.
items.expected: The report limits inference to the initial two-channel comparison and reports model/search limitations.
